player_prompt.intro:
A yi'i solvin Sokoban puzzle. A yi'i player kuma a yi'i bukaci a ɗuuji kese boxes ɗuuji targets.
        So a yi'i ɗuuji kusa da box, a yi'i ɗuuji pushi ɗum ngam roɓe nder diisa ɗum.
        A yi'i ɗuuji pushi box ngam roɓe ta wall, kuma a yi'i ɗuuji puli box.
        Nder board, objekti ɗuuji wakilta kamar haka: 
        - Player (a) o anɗi kamar 'P' 
        - Walls ɗuuji wakilta da '#' 
        - Boxes ɗuuji marki kamar 'X' 
        - Empty goals ɗuuji nuni da 'O'
        - Boxes ɗuuji goals ɗuuji visuali da '√'
        A yi'i ɗuuji yi'i [w] ngam roɓe, [a] ngam hampi, [s] ngam ɗuuji, kuma [d] ngam yimi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hakkunde maa yeeso woodani ko hebdii. Soo [up], [down], [left], [right] walla [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Miɗo tawo ngal daɗɗe ba, miɗo jooɗaaku.
invalid_move.wall_collision: A waawataa yahugo ha nder mahol!
invalid_move.invalid_position: Jaɓɓorgo Caka - footay jaɓɓa yahude to ɗon darnde.

outcome.win: Koɗol belɗum! A timmini dabare Sokoban.
outcome.turn_limit: Limgal waylugo yotti. A timminii jahol yeeso man.
